name: com.52choujiang/weibo-insights
title: SocialDataX 微博 Weibo MCP
description: 微博 / Weibo MCP for hot search, post search/details, comments/replies, likers, reposts, user profiles, user posts, and speech-to-text transcript.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key from SocialDataX / 社媒数据助手

tools.name: weibo_get_hot_search_list
tools.description: Get the current Weibo / 微博 hot search list.

tools.name: weibo_search_posts
tools.description: Search Weibo posts by keyword with optional page_token continuation; do not pass page.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_detail_by_post_id
tools.description: Fetch structured post details when the caller already has a post_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_detail_by_post_url
tools.description: Resolve a Weibo post page link, short link, or share text into structured post details.

tools.name: weibo_submit_video_speech_text_by_post_url
tools.description: Submit a Weibo post video speech-to-text transcript task from a post page link, short link, or share text. 提交完成后最多短等 15 秒；if not finished, returns a job handle.

tools.name: weibo_submit_video_speech_text_by_post_id
tools.description: Submit a Weibo post video speech-to-text transcript task from a post_id. 提交完成后最多短等 15 秒；if not finished, returns a job handle.

tools.name: weibo_get_video_speech_text_job
tools.description: Check a Weibo video speech-to-text transcript job by job_id without starting a new task. This v1 surface returns transcript only, not summary.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_comments_by_post_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments when the caller already has a post_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_comments_by_post_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments directly from a Weibo post page link, short link, or share text.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_comment_replies_by_comment_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated replies under a first-level comment by post_id and comment_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_liker_list_by_post_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated users who liked a Weibo post by post_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_liker_list_by_post_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated users who liked a Weibo post from a post page link, short link, or share text.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_repost_list_by_post_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated reposts for a Weibo post by post_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_post_repost_list_by_post_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated reposts for a Weibo post from a post page link, short link, or share text.

tools.name: weibo_get_user_info_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch user profile data when the caller already has a user_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_user_info_by_profile_url
tools.description: Resolve a Weibo profile link, short link, or share text into user profile data.

tools.name: weibo_get_user_posts_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of posts published by a user when the caller already has a user_id.

tools.name: weibo_get_user_posts_by_profile_url
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of posts published by a user from a profile link, short link, or share text.
